title: Delivery Reliability — Coordinating Procurement, Projects and Quality
summary: I established one tracking rule for the team: keep the original customer commitment in the tracker, and have project management record factory shipment dates and quantities separately. When a gap appeared, the eight-person team across procurement, projects and quality could trace it through molding, air drying and hot pressing. The team managed more than 20 suppliers.
context: The three functions needed a shared view of supplier performance, project progress and quality issues.
decisions: I defined responsibilities and handoffs in departmental SOPs, introduced a shared knowledge system and integrated reporting across teams. I also led strategic sourcing and negotiations with key suppliers.
outcome: The operation managed more than 20 suppliers and exported more than 300 million units during my tenure. Procurement savings averaged US$300,000 annually.
